exposure: internal iliac artery balloon occlusion catheters
surgical ligation of the iliac arteries
cohort: Women with morbidly adherent placenta treated with cesarean hysterectomy at 5 institutions from May 2014 to April 2018.
finding: Aortic and iliac artery balloon occlusion prior to cesarean hysterectomy for morbidly adherent placenta were associated with lower estimated blood loss, transfusion requirements, intensive care unit admission rates, and adverse event rates compared to internal iliac artery ligation or no adjunctive procedures.
